After both updates, same-cell collision, an edge swap, or the player in the robot's new forward vision cells is fatal. Vision is a straight cardinal ray of length 2, stopped by a wall. Reach the exit alive within 30 actions; at tick 30 a surviving exit arrival succeeds, otherwise timeout. A fatal event takes precedence over reaching the exit. Reason from the observations and choose your action yourself.
